title: Listing Clean-Span Bonus on Action-Plan Relief, Seller Performance Standing
content:
**Bonus.** The listing clean-span bonus is the long listing-span bonus of 2 points when six or more whole calendar months have passed since the most recent listing policy or restricted product violation was recorded, the mid listing-span bonus of 1 point when four or five have passed, and nothing when fewer have passed; a seller with no such violation on record takes the long listing-span bonus.

Under Seller Performance Standing this bonus belongs to action-plan relief. It is added after the covered points multiplied by the action-plan share have been rounded down to a whole point, and the action-plan cap applies to the total.

## Measuring the listing span

The span runs from the recording date of the most recent violation of either listing type — listing policy or restricted product, whichever is later — to the handling date, in whole calendar months counted by calendar date. Violations of the other four types play no part.

| Whole months since the most recent listing policy or restricted product violation | Bonus |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2 points |
| 4 or 5 | 1 point |
| 0 to 3 | none |
| no such violation on record | 2 points |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical handling date 15 September)

| Most recent listing-type violation recorded on | Whole months passed | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| 15 March | 6 | 2 |
| 16 March | 5 | 1 |
| 15 May | 4 | 1 |
| 16 May | 3 | none |

**Worked figure.** Rounded-down share points of 1 with a bonus of 2 total 3 before the cap.
